card.name: Inside drug salt names
card.fires_on: The piece of a drug's salt name that comes just before the ending, such as 'umar' in formoterol fumarate or 'male' in timolol maleate. It also fires on 'sodium' after a drug name.

modes.label: Fumarate and maleate
modes.description: Partway through salt names like fumarate or maleate that follow a drug name.

modes.label: Other salt or grade words
modes.description: Salt or grade words after a drug name, such as sodium or USP.
modes.example: Co-administration of pantoprazole<< sodium>> in healthy subjects
